name: qbr-renewal
description: Analyze a supplied QBR PowerPoint or PDF and directly prepare a source-backed renewal or discovery conversation brief.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your QBR file into a clear conversation brief
interface.longDescription: Bring your own QBR PowerPoint or PDF. QBR Conversations analyzes it and directly prepares a one-page CSM brief: value already realised, YoY and peer context, focus areas, product-linked next value moves, and discovery questions. Combines the value-conversation evidence method, Scaled CS recommendations and selective release checks. Google Drive and Z2 support research. No QBR website generation, deck delivery, upload, conversion or bridge is required.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the attached QBR and prepare a one-page renewal conversation brief.
Use my QBR file to explain value already realised, focus areas and product-linked next value moves.
Analyze this QBR for a discovery meeting, including YoY and industry comparisons where supported.
